comparison.objective: Remove one terminal block from a loose DIN rail without disturbing adjacent blocks.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize the rail while pushing, tipping, and sliding a snap-fit block off its latch.
comparison.success_condition: Target block is released into the tray while neighbors and rail remain within strict displacement limits.
comparison.reason: Contact-rich latch release and dismounting are different from reversible captive-screw unlocking, fine collar rotation, relocking, and repeated damping tests.
